v2rayN 7.24.9 - redistribution notices and source access

This repository links official upstream release assets; no installer, split
package parts or source mirrors are distributed here. Original license and
historical verification references are retained for the pinned packages.
No upstream endorsement or replacement license is implied.

v2rayN: Copyright (c) 2017-2026 2dust.
Attribution is derived from the exact release's v2rayN/Directory.Build.props:
https://github.com/2dust/v2rayN/blob/521230c40d5c180bc0727cf4003907edfae5a3e0/v2rayN/Directory.Build.props
The upstream metadata declares GPL-3.0. The complete upstream license is in
v2rayN-GPL-3.0.txt. The program is provided without warranty as stated there.

Included third-party components retain their own copyrights and terms. Read the
verbatim license and notice files in this directory. In particular:
- sing-box 1.13.19: GPL version 3 or later, plus the upstream naming/association
  restriction reproduced in sing-box-LICENSE.txt. The complete GPL version 3
  text is also supplied in v2rayN-GPL-3.0.txt.
- mihomo 1.19.29: the complete GPL version 3 license from that exact tag is in
  mihomo-GPL-3.0.txt. Do not substitute the current default branch's license.
- Xray 26.7.28 as packaged by autorepobot/Xray: Mozilla Public License 2.0,
  reproduced in Xray-MPL-2.0.txt. Its source is the pinned fork, not an assumption
  that the binary is identical to the XTLS release.
- .NET runtime and WPF 10.0.11: MIT licenses and the full upstream third-party
  notices are supplied separately.
- Wintun 0.14.1: the signed binary has the accompanying Wintun prebuilt-binaries
  license, not merely the source project's GPL license. It remains unmodified
  and is distributed alongside software using the permitted Wintun API.
- Avalonia, GlobalHotKeys and SkiaSharp notices are supplied at the source
  versions identified in source-availability.json.

Source access: ../../sources/manifest.json records exact source commits,
public HTTPS archive links and previously recorded hashes. Source archives
are not included locally. source-availability.json retains source trees,
build instructions and license provenance. The GUI source archive omits its
GlobalHotKeys git submodule; a separate pinned source URL is listed.
Recipients redistributing downloaded packages remain responsible for complete
Corresponding Source access under applicable terms. These links are not an
indefinite written source offer or a complete compliance certification.

Historical verification scope (before release bytes were removed): the former locally stored Windows archive and parts were SHA-256 verified. Read-only binary inspection confirms the sing-box
and mihomo commits and .NET 10.0.11 runtime references. The inspected Xray executable
is byte-identical to the authenticated-by-published-digest autorepobot release
member. The inspected Wintun DLL is byte-identical to the official 0.14.1 signed
DLL. No executable was launched for this inventory.

This is a scoped notice/source inventory, not a complete software bill of
materials or a completed audit of every embedded native library, Go/NuGet
transitive dependency, rules database, data attribution, or non-Windows package.
Known remaining checks and the scope of every version assertion are recorded
in source-availability.json. Do not represent those checks as completed.
